cells: Default persistence setting for MSDF fonts. When true, generated MSDF fonts will be cached to IndexedDB on disk. Default: false (memory-only in active session). [Source line 13](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/font/FontLoader.ts#L13).
public static async msdf(source: FontSource, options?: MSDFOptions): Promise<Font>

Loads or generates an MSDF font for SDFText rendering. - If given a JSON URL (pre-baked font), loads the static JSON and PNG directly. - If given a Google Font name, URL, or local TTF/OTF, generates the MSDF atlas via WASM in background. - If options.persist (or FontLoader.defaultPersist) is true, caches to IndexedDB.
